abstract: Sixty-two consecutive patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular cancer were entered into a prospective study to receive no treatment after orchiectomy until clinical evidence of recurrent disease. Of 59 evaluable cases, 41 (69.5%) remained continuously disease free for a median duration of 30 months (range, 18 to 46 months), and evidence of metastatic disease developed in 18 patients (30.5%) from 2 to 36 months after orchiectomy. The median disease-free interval for relapsing patients was 6 months. Retroperitoneal metastases developed in ten patients; seven patients had pulmonary metastases, and one patient had progressive elevation of the serum alpha-fetoprotein level. Relapses were significantly more frequent in patients with either embryonal carcinoma, infiltrating testicular cancer (pT greater than 1), peritumoral vascular invasion, or in those who underwent transscrotal biopsy. One patient with relapse refused salvage therapy and died. The remaining 17 patients have been rendered disease free with cisplatin combination chemotherapy and/or surgery. However, two patients showed further recurrence, with one in the lung and the other one also in the retroperitoneal nodes. In our opinion, surveillance following orchiectomy will provide useful information in clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular cancer, but it is a difficult study. For the time being, it should be restricted to specialized centers only. In the meanwhile, retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy remains the standard treatment.
abstract_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ精巣がん患者62例を対象に、精巣摘除術後に臨床的再発の証拠が出るまで無治療とする前向き研究を行った。評価可能な59例のうち、41例(69.5%)が中央値30か月(範囲18~46か月)にわたり無病生存を維持した。18例(30.5%)は術後2~36か月に転移性疾患を発症した。再発患者の無病期間中央値は6か月であった。後腹膜転移は10例、肺転移は7例に認め、1例では血清αフェトプロテインの進行性上昇を認めた。胎児性癌、浸潤性精巣腫瘍(pT>1)、腫瘍周囲の血管侵襲、または経陰嚢生検を受けた患者では再発が有意に多かった。再発患者1例は救援治療を拒否し死亡した。残る17例はシスプラチン併用化学療法および/または手術により寛解となった。ただし2例はさらに再発し、1例は肺、1例は後腹膜リンパ節であった。当科の見解では、精巣摘除後の経過観察は臨床病期I非セミノーマ精巣がんにおいて有用な情報をもたらすが、困難な研究である。当面は専門施設に限定すべきである。その間、後腹膜リンパ節郭清が標準治療であり続ける。
